scripts.dev:discord-stack:local: npm run dev:discord-stack:clean && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:discord-api" "npm run dev -w discord-hub-web -- --mode direct"
scripts.dev:discord-stack:pi: npm run dev:discord-stack:clean && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:discord-api" "npm run dev -w discord-hub-web -- --mode caddy"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n discord,tools -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:tools"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @clanker/hub-pg-migrate && npm run typecheck -w @clanker/hub-pg-migrate && npm run typecheck -w discord-hub-web && npm run typecheck -w dev-tools-web && npm run typecheck -w discord-hub-api && npm run typecheck -w discord-bot
scripts.test: npm run test -w discord-bot && npm run test -w discord-hub-api
